title: So I'm a Spider, So What?
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A high school class dies in a misfired space-time spell and is reborn in an RPG-like world. One girl, Hiiro Wakaba, wakes as a weak spider monster in a deadly labyrinth and survives by eating, fighting and evolving, while her classmates are reborn as royals and nobles caught in a war between the Hero and the Demon Lord Ariel. The god-like Administrator D watches over it all and is revealed as the cause of their rebirth.
life_message: It holds up stubborn, resourceful survival and finding one's own place, whatever form one is born into.
